cases.name: preference_isolation

limits: This browser campaign used a synthetic native peer, not a real provider or client qualification.
Accessibility evidence covers keyboard behavior, semantic accessibility snapshots, theme and layout; no named screen-reader product was operated.
Unknown-outcome, cleanup and executor source matrices are covered by backend/navigation tests; not every classifier was separately seeded in this root browser instance.
503 and 403 rendering were injected at the browser response boundary. Real backend auth/revocation contracts are covered separately by installed tests.
Initial screenshot with fullPage did not expand the dashboard's scroll container; viewport screenshots were used for visual inspection.
